topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and overview of the lecture topics without introducing substantive course material.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition, pattern recognition receptors, and signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue injury using molecular patterns, pattern recognition receptors, and downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory leukocyte trafficking and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate the inflammatory cascade, directing cell migration into tissues and lymph nodes, as well as the systemic risks of severe inflammatory activation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms responsible for shutting down acute inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and managing chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the subsequent lecture.
